svg.title: Data collection, rubric annotation, and judge paradigm workflow
svg.desc: Three-column infographic. Left frame inventories user query, query-based filter, web implementation with Code A/B icons, env-based filter, compatibility-validity arrow, and Web A/B rendered pages. Middle frame inventories verifiable rubric tree with root and intention/static/dynamic branches, query-grounded arrow from query, annotate arrow, preference-label box, and WebDevJudge formula. Right frame inventories judge with evaluator/observation top split, agentic/interaction split, and paradigm pairwise/single choices. Content is arranged left-to-right with horizontal symmetry in the top headers and vertical grouping in each panel. SAM mappings used after native construction: Code A/B icons, small rubric category icons, evaluator model logos, magnifier/scales icons, agentic and paradigm icons are inserted at original source-crop coordinates while preserving frames/text/arrows.
